## Type of change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update
- [ ] 🔒 Security hardening
- [ ] ♻️ Refactor (no functional change)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement

- [ ] 🔧 CI / build / config change

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the [code-style guide](./docs/code-review.md) (no `console.log` in `src/`).
- [ ] I have run `bun run lint` and `bun run type-check` locally.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or my feature works.
- [ ] I have updated [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md) under the `[Unreleased]` section.
- [ ] I have updated the relevant docs (`README.md`, `USAGE.md`, `docs/*`).
- [ ] My commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
- [ ] This PR is atomic (one logical change) and under 400 lines (or has a strong justification).
- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) and [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md).
